english: ...Mm-mm-mm.
This is... not Akihabara...?\nLost after all...? Auu...
I have to get back to the shoot\nsoon...\nWhere even IS this...?
// Passes by a vending machine
H-huh?\nThis vending machine feels kinda... strange...?
Mmuuu~?\nStaaare...
Ah! I get it—everything's 100 yen!
And the cans have such a retro design...\nand there don't seem to be any\nplastic-bottle drinks...?
// Approaches a phone booth
And there are tons of phone booths!\nAnd they're yellow...
That's it!\nOnce more, on my phone—\nI'll call my manager!
// Dial tone, but no connection
...No signal after all.\nIs there no reception...?
What do I do—at this rate,\nI'll cause the staff\nso much trouble...!
Ah! Those people over there, could they be...?\nIt's dark so I can't see well...
// Sonico spots the group of dream demons and walks toward them, off screen
That's st-range~?\nI thought she'd be toward that soft-serve-shaped cloud,\nbut where'd she go?
Judging direction by cloud shapes... and besides,\nit's night... you can really see them, huh...
She might've been taken in by the police, but...
B-but what if she ran into\none of those dream demon things...?
Geez! Stop saying ominous stuff~!\nIt'll tank our luck! Hesitation is defeat!\nLet's head toward that star!
Stars... well, better than clouds...\nBut splitting up is dangerous too... fine!
// Fade to black\n// Background: town at night
Ah! Everyone,\ns-sorry I'm late!\nSuper Sonico has returned!
...H-huh?
Is this shoot's concept...\nlike this? But I don't see\na cameraman anywhere...
Wawah!\nEveryone, your makeup is SO authentic!
// Dream demons unresponsive; awkward pause hangs in the air
...Ah
A-auu...!\nF-for being late, I-I'm\ntruly sorry!
I'll go change right away!\nWhere are the costumes...?
Awawah!?
// Event still: lifted into the air by tentacle-like things, clothes nearly coming off
Eh!? W-w-w-what...!?\nWh-what's happening...?
Ah... c-could this be...!
The shoot's already started!
The suddenness is\nto capture natural expressions, maybe...\nor the theme is surprise...?
But this outfit all of a sudden...!\nIt's work, but still, I'm so embarrassed~!
Awawah!\nUu, i-is this pose really okay...
Gyaah!?\nIf you pull like that, my—my clothes—ahh~!
// Event art off\n// Claude and the others arrive.
Tch, bad!\nShe's been caught!
Hmm, looks less like 'caught' and more like\n'being toyed with'?
Th-th-this is no time to be relaxed~!
Really? Turning it around\nfrom a position like that is the fun part!
...?\nYou seem to have picked up\nquite the eccentric battle theory.
If you don't get it, FEEL it!\nAnyway, that girl's got SOMETHING that charms the audience!
An interesting topic, but\nlet's save it for later.
If that girl isn't safe, it's all for nothing!
Ahaha, true enough!
You there! I'll save you now!
// Please play Symphogear's battle theme
// To battle map
Don't move! I'll take it down in one hit!
Ah! You're the one from before...
B-but, this is a shoot...!
We fought those dream demons just now too.\nThey've got nothing to do with your job!
Eh! But...
Geez, we're saving you for now!\nMy magic'll surprise you!!
// Event triggers when the dream demon adjacent to Sonico is defeated
Auu... th-that was a rough shoot...
U-um... are you SURE\nthe staff didn't\nset this up?
If you were shooting,\nthe director would come flying over.
Ah! Y-you're right...
// Dream demons appear as reinforcements
Gyaah! More of their friends!?
They've surrounded us!?\nFor a photo shoot, hmm,\nyou wouldn't need this many, right?
Y-you're right... then\nwho ARE those people over there...?
Talk later.\nSecuring your safety comes first!
Yeah! I'll do my best!
Then I'll cheer from the back...
// After defeating a set number of dream demons, Black Rena appears
Hm?\nSomeone's coming?
A sailor uniform...?\nIs that girl a civilian too?
It's dangerous here!\nEvacuate immediately!
Looks like that was pointless.\nLook at how she's acting!
That aura she wears, darker than the night's darkness...\nIs she with that black mobile unit from before?
...Crush it...\nmince it fine... I've gotta erase it...
What are you saying!?\nWho even are you...?
Wooow, she's carrying something dangerous!\nDoesn't look like she'll talk either, so\nfortune comes to... whatchamacallit~.
// Battle continues
That's awful... and I believed...
Oh dear, she's gone...
Her safety comes first right now!\nNo chasing after!
Ugh! Unsatisfying, but oh well!
// Black Rena vanishes; battle continues\n// Wipe out all enemies to clear
Glad we made it in time.\nYou're not hurt?
Y-yes!\nThank you\nfor worrying about me...!
You, um...
Um, I'm\nSuper Sonico!
I do part-time work\nas a gravure model,\nand right now I was in the middle of a shoot...
Ah! That's right, the shoot location!\nUm, pardon me, but where\nexactly are we...?
At the very least, this isn't a shoot location.\nBut there's something I want to ask:\nisn't this town unfamiliar to you?
Yes... uu, actually...\nI had a shoot in Akihabara today, but\nI must have taken a wrong turn somewhere...
Akihabara? Never heard of that place.\nYou got lost on your way to\nthe shoot location?
Huh? Um, well...
// Fade to black: time passes
...and that's how it went.
A bright light during the shoot, huh.\nAnd then your vision went white for a moment...
Yes. When I could see again,\nthe staff were\nall gone...
So while I was searching all over,\nI ran into all of you!
Tsubasa, this girl too, as expected...
Yes. Same as us.
The same...?\nMe and all of you...?
That's right.\nBut you don't need to be scared.
Geez! What on earth is even happening!!\nI don't get any of this~!!
Isn't some nasty screenwriter just\nwriting whatever they want?
A script... Ah!\nSo THAT'S what you meant by 'the same'!\nI understand!
Huh...?
Huh...?
Um, sorry!\nI still haven't gotten a script,\nso I don't even know my role name...
W-wait... do NONE of you\nhave scripts...?
I think you're misunderstanding something...?
Yes, I'm misunderstanding—I'm so sorry!
So this job isn't\na photo shoot,\nit's an ACTION MOVIE shoot!
The reason there's no cameraman is\nthey're hiding somewhere\nto capture natural expressions...?
No, that's not it...\nThe fight just now\nwasn't being filmed, you know?
Wawa!? So that was rehearsal...?\nAmazing intensity for a rehearsal!\nUu~! I've got to do my best too!
N-no, that's not it...
Hey Tsubasa,\nthere's a saying—'ignorance is bliss'—\nso maybe it's fine to leave things as they are?
(If I tell her the truth and scare her,\nshe might panic)
(I see... maybe so.\nNo need to stir up extra worry, then)
Huh... is something wrong, everyone?
Ah, yeah. It's fine.\nYou just stay natural like that.
Y-yes! Understood!\nAh, but what about my role name...?
Super Sonico's fine!\nIt's got impact!
My real name, even! This film is\nreally committed to naturalness...
Um, in that case,\nI also have the nickname\nNico-chan...
That's a bit embarrassing, so\nI'll call you Sonico.
Y-yes, understood!\nI'm inexperienced, but\nplease treat me well from now on!
...Um, speaking of which, 'the same'\nmeans you all saw that paah,\npikaa flash of light too?
(She gets THAT part...)
// Light appears
Like... this...?
Yeah, like—wait!? Not again!?
At this timing... this is...!!
H-huh? ...GYAAAH~!
// END
